note: vulnerable_through is the last vulnerable release in each branch, inclusive. Every branch below 8.2 is end-of-life and its final release is still vulnerable, so there is no fixed release for it. The 8.2-8.5 cutoffs match the official advisory exactly; the end-of-life cutoffs were cross-checked against the final releases published on php.net (8.1.34, 8.0.30, 7.4.33, 5.6.40).
